INSERT INTO "ProtocolCredential" (id, "clientId", protocol,
                                                          "encryptedSecret", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
                       VALUES ($1, $2, $3::text::"Protocol", $4, $5, $5)
                       ON CONFLICT ("clientId", protocol) DO UPDATE SET
                         "encryptedSecret" = EXCLUDED."encryptedSecret",
                         "updatedAt" = EXCLUDED."updatedAt"
